title: Dependency Readiness Index and Handoff Matrix
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable framework and set of artifacts to measure and track team-to-team dependency readiness across the roadmap. Deliverables: a Dependency Readiness Index (DRI) that scores readiness per dependency, a Handoff Matrix documenting exact touchpoints and owners for each milestone, and an operational runbook for weekly triage and escalations. This will reduce last-mile slippage caused by unclear ownership, brittle integration points, and late discovery of infra/security blockers.
acceptance_criteria: DRI calculation defined and documented with source data mapping (e.g., API contract signoff, infra tickets, infra capacity, design specs)
Handoff Matrix template created and populated for Q2 roadmap 6 high-risk initiatives
Weekly triage workflow defined and trialed for 4 cycles with PM/ENG/Design/Security/Infra attendees
Dashboards in Looker/Grafana showing DRI trends and top 10 blockers updated nightly
Escalation playbook with SLAs (e.g., 48h unblock or exec notification) published in Confluence
milestones: M2: Handoff Matrix template + pilot population (by 2026-03-19)
M4: Runbook + exec reporting and handoff to PMOps (by 2026-04-10)
